name: Databricks Lakebase Chat Memory
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: Use the Databricks Lakebase Chat Memory node to store chat history in a Databricks Lakebase table as memory[^1] for your AI agents. The node reads and writes the table over the Lakebase Data API, so it needs no connection string or database driver

parameters.name: Project
parameters.description: Select the Lakebase project from the list, or select By ID and enter its project ID

parameters.name: Branch
parameters.description: Select the branch of the project from the list, or select By ID and enter its branch ID, for example production

parameters.name: Database
parameters.description: Select the Postgres database on the branch from the list, or select By ID and enter its Postgres database name, for example databricks_postgres

parameters.name: Schema
parameters.description: The Postgres schema that holds the table. Defaults to public, and the list offers only public. For another schema, select By ID and enter its name. The Data API has to expose that schema

parameters.name: Table Name
parameters.description: Enter the name of the table to store the chat history in. Defaults to n8n_chat_histories. The node doesn't create the table. Refer to Create the table

parameters.name: Session ID
parameters.description: Select how the node finds the session ID:

parameters.name: Context Window Length
parameters.description: Enter the number of previous interactions to consider for context. Defaults to 5

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: This node must be connected to an AI agent. Insert one

parameters.name: lakebaseDatabase
parameters.description: The Postgres database on the branch

parameters.name: lakebaseSchema
parameters.description: The Postgres schema. To use a schema other than public, select By ID and enter its name.

parameters.name: lakebaseTable
parameters.description: The table in the schema that stores the chat history

parameters.name: createTableNotice
parameters.displayName: This node cannot create the table. Create it in the Lakebase SQL editor before the first run. A run against a missing table shows the SQL to copy.

options.name: Connected Chat Trigger Node
options.description: Looks for an input field called 'sessionId' that is coming from a directly connected Chat Trigger

options.name: Define below
options.description: Use an expression to reference data in previous nodes or enter static text

parameters.name: scopedSessionHintNotice
parameters.displayName: Session is automatically scoped only to this memory node. To share a session between different memory nodes, switch "Session ID" to "Define below" and use the same key in each node.

parameters.name: sessionKey
parameters.description: The key to use to store session ID in the memory
